```{r }
  filter(!is.na(uni_lemma))  %>% 
  mutate(word = uni_lemma) %>%

  select (word, theword, uni_lemma, language, category)
```

```{r }

  mutate(uni_lemma = str_to_lower(uni_lemma))

korean_sample2 <- korean_sample2 %>% 
  mutate(Word = str_to_lower(Word))
```

```{r }
build_lemma_map <- function(
  korean_words,
  korean_sample,
  word_col = "Word",
  form_col = "theword",
  lemma_col = "uni_lemma",
  language_col = "language",
  language = "Korean"
) {

  library(dplyr)

  # 1. Identify homonyms in the lexicon
  homonym_forms <- korean_words %>%
    filter(.data[[language_col]] == language) %>%
    group_by(.data[[form_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n_lemmas = n_distinct(.data[[lemma_col]]),
      lemmas = list(unique(.data[[lemma_col]])),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_lemmas > 1)

  # 2. Homonyms that actually appear in the sample
  sample_homonyms <- korean_sample %>%
    distinct(.data[[form_col]]) %>%
    inner_join(homonym_forms, by = setNames(form_col, form_col))

  # 3. Meanings used in the sample for those forms
  sample_meanings <- korean_sample %>%
    semi_join(sample_homonyms, by = setNames(form_col, form_col)) %>%
    distinct(
      theword = .data[[form_col]],
      Word    = .data[[word_col]]
    )

  # 4. Safe auto-matching (exact string match only)
  auto_lemma_map <- sample_meanings %>%
    left_join(
      korean_words %>%
        select(
          theword = .data[[form_col]],
          uni_lemma = .data[[lemma_col]]
        ),
      by = "theword"
    ) %>%
    filter(Word == uni_lemma) %>%
    select(Word, uni_lemma) %>%
    distinct()

  # 5. Unresolved meanings (true ambiguity)
  unresolved <- sample_meanings %>%
    anti_join(auto_lemma_map, by = "Word")

  # 6. Return everything needed for inspection + downstream use
  list(
    lemma_map = auto_lemma_map,
    unresolved = unresolved,
    homonym_forms = homonym_forms,
    sample_homonyms = sample_homonyms
  )
}

```

```{r }
lemma_results <- build_lemma_map(
  korean_words = korean_words,
  korean_sample = korean_sample2
)

lemma_results$unresolved
lemma_results$homonym_forms
lemma_results$sample_homonyms


korean_sample2_fixed <- korean_sample2 %>%
  left_join(lemma_results$lemma_map, by = "Word")

final_data <- korean_sample2_fixed %>%
  left_join(
    korean_words,
    by = c("theword", "uni_lemma", "language")
  )

```
